page.overview:
What is Customs and Ceremonies of the Tairen Court?

Customs and Ceremonies of the Tairen Court is a book left behind when a group of Black Ajah fled the White Tower. It was used as a taunt and bait so that Nynaeve al'Meara, Elayne Trakand, and Egwene al'Vere would chase the Black sisters to Tear.
